text: Honeymooning in Hungary, the novelist Peter Alison and his wife Joan share a night train with Werdegast, a psychiatrist freed after fifteen years in a Siberian prison camp. A crash on a rainy road strands them in the [house Poelzig built on the ruins of Fort Marmorus|images|buildings and public places], the fort he [betrayed to the Russians|wrong|broken trust]. Werdegast has come [to settle that debt|wants|revenge for a wrong], while Poelzig keeps dead women in glass cases and plans [a midnight ceremony with Joan at its centre|wants|the sacrifice demanded].
